Resolves #19194

`CONTRIBUTING.md` §3 item 3 now states the claim rule as @tobiu set it on 2026-09-24:
- Comment to claim, and we assign the first person who asks.
- An unassigned PR is allowed, but the first approve-worthy PR for a ticket is the one merged.
- So an assignment is what protects your time.

Item 1's good-first-issue sentence points to item 3 rather than repeating it. The 7-day reassignment sentence stays. The text promises no response time, because claims don't reach a maintainer automatically yet; that notification is a separate #18985 leaf.

Evidence: L1 (a documentation diff) → L1 required.
